name: 24019 · Roanoke, VA
findings: ZIP 24019 (Roanoke) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24019 (Roanoke) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
